mechanism.populationDetail: EvE explicitly maintains two co-evolving flat populations: functional solver candidates and scored agent-guidance states.
mechanism.archiveDetail: High-performing reference solvers and Elo-ranked agent guidance are sampled with rank bias; all new candidates are also inserted into expanding populations.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The agent population expands with revised guidance plus session logs; solver candidates are accumulated. Synchronous races compare candidates from identical reference sets.
mechanism.generationDetail: Working agents produce modified solver code and may revise guidance/skills through scoped filesystem edits; exact edit locality/operator templates are not fixed.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Two populations co-evolve, with guidance-agent fitness credited only through downstream solver improvement in synchronous Elo races.

provenance.citationWarning: Population labels approximate growing scored sets as multi-elite archives; agent Elo determines sampling but exact parent inheritance/cardinality is not formalized.
